description: Fetching geometries and boundaries of cadastral parcels, cadastral districts and municipalities by TERYT code or XY point coordinates.
Aggregated parcel boundaries, cadastral numbers, classification contours and land use types from all counties in Poland.
Official boundaries of Poland's territorial division (country, voivodeships, counties, municipalities, cadastral districts).

service: EMUiA (Register of Localities, Streets and Addresses)
description: Point locations of all address numbers and street centrelines in Poland.
Standardized names of localities, physiographic features, rivers, peaks and forests.
Vector general-geographic database corresponding to the 1:250,000 scale for the whole country.
Boundaries of reference blocks and parcels reported to the land records and area-based payments.
Anonymized annual structure of sown crops and land use in Poland determined with remote sensing methods.
Uniform European land cover and land use classification (44 classes) for the whole of Poland.
High-resolution land use classification for urban functional areas (FUA).

service: NMT GUGiK (Digital Terrain Model, 1 m grid)
format: WCS, WMS, ARC/INFO ASCII GRID, GeoTIFF
description: High-resolution terrain elevation model from airborne laser scanning (LiDAR 1x1 m) for slope, aspect and depression analyses.
Elevation model that includes objects above the terrain: buildings, forests, tree cover (wind barrier effect, shading).
Original point clouds from airborne scanning (density 4-12 points/m2) with classification of ground, buildings and vegetation.
Uniform elevation model with 30 m resolution for the whole of Europe for regional analyses.
Aerial photographs with a 5-25 cm pixel in natural colours (RGB) and near infrared (CIR) for interpreting terrain objects.
Detailed vector topographic map of Poland (1:10,000): road and rail networks, watercourses, buildings, fences, ditches.
Routes of underground and overhead utility networks (water supply, sewage, gas, electricity, telecommunications).
Full vector database of roads, paths, buildings, POI points and boundaries with daily updates.

service: GDDKiA (Average Daily Traffic and National Road Network)
description: Geometry of national roads, motorways and expressways together with the results of the General Traffic Measurement (GPR).
Current (hourly) measurements from synoptic stations in Poland: temperature, precipitation, humidity, wind, pressure.
Telemetry measurements every 10 minutes from automatic stations: ground temperature at 5 cm, 10-minute precipitation.

service: IMGW-PIB Meteorological and Hydrological Warnings API
description: Active warnings by county (storms, hail, heat waves, frost, strong wind, high water).
Multi-year archives of daily and term meteorological observations for climate trend analyses and thermal balances.
Maps of radar reflectivity and precipitation intensity every 5-10 minutes (detection of local downpours and hail).
Free high-resolution (2 km) hourly forecasts including temperature and soil moisture at depths of 0-54 cm.
Historical reanalyses of land parameters (climate, radiation, profile moisture) on a 9 km grid since 1950.
Basic hydrographic division of the country: catchment boundaries, watersheds, watercourse axes and reservoirs.
Flood zones for flood probabilities of 10% (once in 10 years), 1% (once in 100 years) and 0.2%.
Current water levels, flows and water temperatures at river gauging stations across Poland.
Measurements of physicochemical and biological parameters of surface and groundwater.
Climatic Water Balance (KBW) in a ten-day approach and water deficit indicators by municipality.
Soil agricultural suitability complexes, genetic soil types and particle size composition (profile water retention).
Periodic measurements of pH, organic carbon, humus, macro- and micronutrients at 216 permanent points.
Detailed Geological Map of Poland (1:50,000), depth to the first groundwater table and water permeability.

service: MIDAS (Mineral Deposits and Mining Areas Database)
description: Locations of mineral deposits, mining areas and mining grounds in Poland maintained by the Polish Geological Institute.
Register of active and inactive landslides and areas at risk of mass ground movements in Poland.
Global rasters of soil physicochemical properties at 250 m (clay, sand, organic carbon, pH content).
Boundaries of Natura 2000 areas, national parks, landscape parks, nature reserves and ecological sites.
Current telemetry data from air quality monitoring stations in Poland (PM10, PM2.5, NO2, SO2, O3, CO, AQI index).
Multispectral imagery (10-20 m, every 2-5 days): Red-Edge, NIR, SWIR bands (NDVI, NDRE, NDMI, vegetation stress).
Synthetic aperture radar (SAR): cloud-independent measurements of roughness, near-surface moisture and deformation.
Land surface temperature (LST, 1 km) and indicators of atmosphere and vegetation condition on a daily cycle.
Optical (30 m) and thermal TIRS (100 m) imagery for radiation balances and evapotranspiration.
Ready-made 10 m rasters of vegetation dynamics: start, peak and length of the biomass productivity season.
Soil profile moisture index on a daily cycle computed from radar data.
Poland's largest statistical database for municipalities, counties and voivodeships (demography, economy, environment, land use).
